## Which file do I need?

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `veloele.osf` | **Start here.** The complete OsmAnd setup: open it with OsmAnd on your phone to add the Velöle profile (routing, navigation settings, map style, POI filters). |
| `veloele.xml` | Only the OsmAnd routing profile, for installing it by hand. |
| `veloele.brf` | The same routing for BRouter / brouter-web. |
| `veloele.render.xml` | Only the OsmAnd map style. It is already in `veloele.osf`. |

Installation and details: see the [README](https://github.com/Che4ter/Veloele-OSM#readme).
